name: mirage
text:
Socket orders: they are built and ON by default (since v0.92). Taps from your phone go out over a Novig socket and fall back to REST if it fails. I've never seen a real report prove it works. The slow part (about 5.7 s) is Novig finishing the order, not sending it, so the socket alone wouldn't fix it. v1.0.78's report will show whether your taps went by socket or REST, and I'll read that first.

Repeat bets: I can only account for part of it. For UAPB-FAMU Over 55.5, the app logged ONE tap from you: 2:06 PM, $1.38. Your Novig screen shows $6.88 in 7 orders, so about $5.50 came from elsewhere. My guess is it filled in pieces (each partial fill is its own order), or it came from resting bids on that line. GitHub's trade ledger only shows an Under 55.5 bid there, so I haven't confirmed this. UND-SDAK Under 57.5 looks the same: the app logged one $1.79 bet, Novig shows $5.62 in 3 orders. I'm treating this as an open bug and will compare Novig's order list against our logs, game by game. If the repeats are ours, the repeat guard failed. I'll tell you what I find.
